# IC Business Systems

> Web design business in Lawrence, Massachusetts, run by Irving Carrion. Websites, Google Business Profile setup and request forms for plumbers, HVAC companies, other trades and owner-led local businesses. English and Spanish. Not affiliated with IC System, Inc.

- Based in Lawrence, MA. Meets clients in person across the Merrimack Valley (Methuen, Andover, North Andover, Haverhill, Lowell) and southern New Hampshire; works remotely with businesses anywhere.
- Builds custom-coded websites, or works on Squarespace when the owner wants to edit the site.
- Clients keep their own domain and accounts.
- Prices: websites by quote, consulting $75 an hour, monthly website support from $150 a month.
